description: Linked Markdown notes with backlinks, tags, a graph view and shared team spaces.
container.title: Notes
welcome.vault:
Your notes are plain Markdown files in a folder on your computer, so you can also open them with any other app.
[New Note](command:nighthawk.notes.newNote)
[Open Daily Note](command:nighthawk.notes.openDailyNote)
Already use Obsidian? [Use an existing vault](command:nighthawk.notes.changeVault).
welcome.teams.signedOut:
Share notes with your team. Sign in to a Nighthawk Notes server, or run your own from the notes-server folder of the Nighthawk repository.
[Sign In](command:nighthawk.notes.teams.signIn)
[Create Account](command:nighthawk.notes.teams.register)
[Change Server](command:nighthawk.notes.teams.setServer)
welcome.teams.noTeams:
You are not in a team yet. Create one and invite people, or join a team with an invite link or code.
[Create Team](command:nighthawk.notes.teams.createTeam)
[Join Team](command:nighthawk.notes.teams.join)
config.vaultPath: Folder that holds your notes. Leave empty to use a folder named `Nighthawk Notes` in your home folder. An existing Obsidian vault works as is.
config.dailyNotes.folder: Folder in the vault where daily notes are created.
config.dailyNotes.format: File name of daily notes. YYYY, MM, DD, HH and mm are replaced with the date.
config.dailyNotes.template: Name of a template in the templates folder to start daily notes from.
config.templatesFolder: Folder in the vault that holds note templates.
config.server.url: Address of the Nighthawk Notes server used for teams and shared notes.
config.teams.syncInterval: How often, in seconds, to fetch teammates' changes to shared notes. 0 turns automatic syncing off.
config.teams.inviteExpiryHours: How many hours new invite links stay valid.
